messages:
anya: quick sync — product wants per-tenant routing SLAs + a soft-eviction escape hatch. can arch confirm constraints?
leo: short answer: doable but nontrivial. we need tenancy tagging + policy layers. tradeoffs: more cross-region egress and complexity in routing tables.
jonathan: plumbing Qs — do we have telemetry to detect hot tenants that would trigger eviction? we have prefix cache metrics but not per-tenant tail-latency yet.
maria: ops perspective: define launch criteria first. propose canary with 5 tenants, run for 72h, target <0.1% evictions/day and <5ms added p95.
anya: customers require contract language saying we "will attempt to avoid noisy-tenant impact". can we offer soft isolation without dedicated pools?
leo: design idea: three isolation tiers — shared (baseline), soft-isolate (priority routing + rate shaping + overflow lanes), hard-isolate (dedicated capacity). soft-isolate is quickest to deliver (Q3) but not fully SLA-backed.
jonathan: action items from arch: (1) define metrics + SLOs (eviction-rate, cross-region overflow %, p99 latency delta) (2) prototype a routing-policy DSL snippet so product/legal can read it (3) run cost delta sim assuming 25–35% overflow to regions.
maria: ops can run the simulated canary next week if you provide a playbook with exact traffic knobs. I'll reserve canary pool.
anya: i'll draft customer-facing launch criteria and the caveats for soft-isolate. also escalating contract wording to legal. tagging @sre-bot for perf baseline once proto is up.
@sre-bot: perf baseline job queued: model-sim v2 on sample traces. ETA ~18h :hourglass_flowing_sand:
leo: one immediate blocker — RBAC for policy edits. we need a migration path and approval workflow before enabling policy changes in prod.
product-ops: we will own initial policy migrations for the pilot. need a rollback threshold defined (suggest 10% increase in error-rate or 20% latency delta triggers rollback).
anya: ok. sync tomorrow 10am. short agenda: metrics, DSL sketch, rollout plan, owner matrix, RBAC. :white_check_mark:
leo: DSL sketch (very rough):
```
policy route {
  match: tenant in ["t-alpha","t-beta"]
  priority: soft-isolate
  overflow: region=fallback-region
  eviction_threshold: 0.001
}
```
jonathan: nice. i'll wire a small simulator to validate DSL semantics against traces.
maria: scheduling note — ops wants a runbook stub, slack channel, and a clear kill-switch before any canary.
anya: thanks all. i'll circulate the launch-criteria doc after the meeting and assign owners.
leo: tagging engineering leads to review the DSL before the meeting.
anya: closing — see you tomorrow.
